1.sahih_international: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
1.pickthall: Blessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion (of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples.
1.yusuf_ali: Blessed is He who sent down the criterion to His servant, that it may be an admonition to all creatures;-
1.shakir: Blessed is He Who sent down the Furqan upon His servant that he may be a warner to the nations;
1.muhammad_sarwar: Blessed is He who has revealed the criteria (for discerning truth from falsehood) to His servant so that He could warn mankind.
1.mohsin_khan: Blessed be He Who sent down the criterion (of right and wrong, i.e. this Quran) to His slave (Muhammad SAW) that he may be a warner to the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns).
1.arberry: Blessed be He who has sent down the Salvation upon His servant, that he may be a warner to all beings;

2.sahih_international: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
2.pickthall: He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, He hath chosen no son nor hath He any partner in the Sovereignty. He hath created everything and hath meted out for it a measure.
2.yusuf_ali: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: no son has He begotten, nor has He a partner in His dominion: it is He who created all things, and ordered them in due proportions.
2.shakir: He, Whose is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Who did not take to Himself a son, and Who has no associate in the kingdom, and Who created everything, then ordained for it a measure.
2.muhammad_sarwar: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He has not begotten any sons, nor does He have any partner in His kingdom. He has created all things with precisely accurate planning.
2.mohsin_khan: He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Who has begotten no son (children or offspring) and for Whom there is no partner in the dominion. He has created everything, and has measured it exactly according to its due measurements.
2.arberry: to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and He has not taken to Him a son, and He has no associate in the Kingdom; and He created every thing, then He ordained it very exactly.

3.sahih_international: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
3.pickthall: Yet they choose beside Him other gods who create naught but are themselves created, and possess not hurt nor profit for themselves, and possess not death nor life, nor power to raise the dead.
3.yusuf_ali: Yet have they taken, besides him, gods that can create nothing but are themselves created; that have no control of hurt or good to themselves; nor can they control death nor life nor resurrection.
3.shakir: And they have taken besides Him gods, who do not create anything while they are themselves created, and they control not for themselves any harm or profit, and they control not death nor life, nor raising (the dead) to life.
3.muhammad_sarwar: Yet they have chosen for themselves other deities besides Him, who do not create anything but rather are themselves created, who have no power over their own benefits, or trouble, and who have no control over life, death, and resurrection.
3.mohsin_khan: Yet they have taken besides Him other aliha (gods) that created nothing but are themselves created, and possess neither hurt nor benefit for themselves, and possess no power (of causing) death, nor (of giving) life, nor of raising the dead.
3.arberry: Yet they have taken to them gods, apart from Him, that create nothing and themselves are created, and have no power to hurt or profit themselves, no power of death or life or raising up.

4.sahih_international: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur'an] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
4.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie.
4.yusuf_ali: But the misbelievers say: "Naught is this but a lie which he has forged, and others have helped him at it." In truth it is they who have put forward an iniquity and a falsehood.
4.shakir: And those who disbelieve say: This is nothing but a lie which he has forged, and other people have helped him at it; so indeed they have done injustice and (uttered) a falsehood.
4.muhammad_sarwar: The unbelievers say, "This (Quran) is no more than a slanderous statement which he (Muhammad), with the help of some other people, has falsely invented." Certainly, this statement is unjust and sinful.
4.mohsin_khan: Those who disbelieve say: "This (the Quran) is nothing but a lie that he (Muhammad SAW) has invented, and others have helped him at it, so that they have produced an unjust wrong (thing) and a lie."
4.arberry: The unbelievers say, 'This is naught but a calumny he has forged, and other folk have helped him to it.' So they have committed wrong and falsehood.

5.sahih_international: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
5.pickthall: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening.
5.yusuf_ali: And they say: "Tales of the ancients, which he has caused to be written: and they are dictated before him morning and evening."
5.shakir: And they say: The stories of the ancients-- he has got them written-- so these are read out to him morning and evening.
5.muhammad_sarwar: They have also said, "It, (the Quran), is only ancient legends, which were written down while they were dictated to him in the mornings and the evenings".
5.mohsin_khan: And they say: "Tales of the ancients, which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
5.arberry: They say, 'Fairy-tales of the ancients that he has had written down, so that they are recited to him at the dawn and in the evening.'

6.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
6.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful.
6.yusuf_ali: Say: "The (Qur'an) was sent down by Him who knows the mystery (that is) in the heavens and the earth: verily He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
6.shakir: Say: He has revealed it Who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth; surely He is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
6.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "The One who knows all the secrets of the heavens and the earth has revealed it; He is All-forgiving and All-merciful."
6.mohsin_khan: Say: "It (this Quran) has been sent down by Him (Allah) (the Real Lord of the heavens and earth) Who knows the secret of the heavens and the earth. Truly, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
6.arberry: Say: 'He sent it down, who knows the secret in the heavens and earth; He is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.'

7.sahih_international: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
7.pickthall: And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him.
7.yusuf_ali: And they say: "What sort of a messenger is this, who eats food, and walks through the streets? Why has not an angel been sent down to him to give admonition with him?
7.shakir: And they say: What is the matter with this Apostle that he eats food and goes about in the markets; why has not an angel been sent down to him, so that he should have been a warner with him?
7.muhammad_sarwar: They say, "Why does this Messenger eat food, and walk in the streets? Why has not an angel been sent to him so that they could preach the message together?
7.mohsin_khan: And they say: "Why does this Messenger (Muhammad SAW) eat food, and walk about in the markets (like ourselves). Why is not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him?
7.arberry: They also say, 'What ails this Messenger that he eats food, and goes in the markets? Why has an angel not been sent down to him, to be a warner with him?

8.sahih_international: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
8.pickthall: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched.
8.yusuf_ali: "Or (Why) has not a treasure been bestowed on him, or why has he (not) a garden for enjoyment?" The wicked say: "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched."
8.shakir: Or (why is not) a treasure sent down to him, or he is made to have a garden from which he should eat? And the unjust say: You do not follow any but a man deprived of reason.
8.muhammad_sarwar: Why has a treasure not been laid out for him or a garden from which he could eat been given to him." The unjust ones say, "You are merely following a bewitched person".
8.mohsin_khan: "Or (why) has not a treasure been granted to him, or why has he not a garden whereof he may eat?" And the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.) say: "You follow none but a man bewitched."
8.arberry: Or why is not a treasure thrown to him, or why has he not a Garden to eat of?' The evildoers say, 'You are only following a man bewitched!'

9.sahih_international: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
9.pickthall: See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road!
9.yusuf_ali: See what kinds of comparisons they make for thee! But they have gone astray, and never a way will they be able to find!
9.shakir: See what likenesses do they apply to you, so they have gone astray, therefore they shall not be able to find a way.
9.muhammad_sarwar: Look at their various views about you! They have gone astray and are not able to find the right path.
9.mohsin_khan: See how they coin similitudes for you, so they have gone astray, and they cannot find a (Right) Path.
9.arberry: Behold, how they strike similitudes for thee, and go astray, and are unable to find a way!

10.sahih_international: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
10.pickthall: Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions.
10.yusuf_ali: Blessed is He who, if that were His will, could give thee better (things) than those,- Gardens beneath which rivers flow; and He could give thee palaces (secure to dwell in).
10.shakir: Blessed is He Who, if He please, will give you what is better than this, gardens beneath which rivers flow, and He will give you palaces.
10.muhammad_sarwar: Blessed is He who could give you palaces and gardens wherein streams would flow, far better than what they want you to have.
10.mohsin_khan: Blessed be He Who, if He will, will assign you better than (all) that, - Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise) and will assign you palaces (i.e. in Paradise).
10.arberry: Blessed be He who, if He will, shall assign to them better than that -- gardens underneath which rivers flow, and he shall assign to thee palaces.

11.sahih_international: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
11.pickthall: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.
11.yusuf_ali: Nay they deny the hour (of the judgment to come): but We have prepared a blazing fire for such as deny the hour:
11.shakir: But they reject the hour, and We have prepared a burning fire for him who rejects the hour.
11.muhammad_sarwar: They deny the Hour of Doom so We have prepared for them a burning fire.
11.mohsin_khan: Nay, they deny the Hour (the Day of Resurrection), and for those who deny the Hour, We have prepared a flaming Fire (i.e. Hell).
11.arberry: Nay, but they cry lies to the Hour; and We have prepared for him who cries lies to the Hour a Blaze.

12.sahih_international: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
12.pickthall: When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof.
12.yusuf_ali: When it sees them from a place far off, they will hear its fury and its ranging sigh.
12.shakir: When it shall come into their sight from a distant place, they shall hear its vehement raging and roaring.
12.muhammad_sarwar: Even if they were to see [this fire] from a distant place, they would only listen to its raging and roaring.
12.mohsin_khan: When it (Hell) sees them from a far place, they will hear its raging and its roaring.
12.arberry: When it sees them from a far place, they shall hear its bubbling and sighing.

13.sahih_international: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
13.pickthall: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there.
13.yusuf_ali: And when they are cast, bound together into a constricted place therein, they will plead for destruction there and then!
13.shakir: And when they are cast into a narrow place in it, bound, they shall there call out for destruction.
13.muhammad_sarwar: When they are thrown, bound, into a narrow place therein, then only will they wish for their death.
13.mohsin_khan: And when they shall be thrown into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they will exclaim therein for destruction.
13.arberry: And when they are cast, coupled in fetters, into a narrow place of that Fire, they will call out there for destruction.

14.sahih_international: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
14.pickthall: Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions!
14.yusuf_ali: "This day plead not for a single destruction: plead for destruction oft-repeated!"
14.shakir: Call not this day for one destruction, but call for destructions many.
14.muhammad_sarwar: They will be told, "Do not pray to die only once but pray to die many times."
14.mohsin_khan: Exclaim not today for one destruction, but exclaim for many destructions.
14.arberry: 'Call not out today for one destruction, but call for many!'

15.sahih_international: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
15.pickthall: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.
15.yusuf_ali: Say: "Is that best, or the eternal garden, promised to the righteous? for them, that is a reward as well as a goal (of attainment).
15.shakir: Say: Is this better or the abiding garden which those who guard (against evil) are promised? That shall be a reward and a resort for them.
15.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), ask them, "Is what you want better or the eternal garden promised to the pious ones as their reward and dwelling?
15.mohsin_khan: Say: (O Muhammad SAW) "Is that (torment) better or the Paradise of Eternity promised to the Muttaqun (pious and righteous persons - see V. 2:2)?" It will be theirs as a reward and as a final destination.
15.arberry: Say: 'Is that better, or the Garden of Eternity, that is promised to the godfearing, and is their recompense and homecoming?'

16.sahih_international: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
16.pickthall: Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled.
16.yusuf_ali: "For them there will be therein all that they wish for: they will dwell (there) for aye: A promise to be prayed for from thy Lord."
16.shakir: They shall have therein what they desire abiding (in it); it is a promise which it is proper to be prayed for from your Lord.
16.muhammad_sarwar: Therein they will eternally have whatever they want. This is a binding promise from your Lord."
16.mohsin_khan: For them there will be therein all that they desire, and they will abide (there forever). It is a promise binding upon your Lord that must be fulfilled.
16.arberry: Therein they shall have what they will dwelling forever; it is a promise binding upon thy Lord, and of Him to be required.

17.sahih_international: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
17.pickthall: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way?
17.yusuf_ali: The day He will gather them together as well as those whom they worship besides Allah, He will ask: "Was it ye who let these My servants astray, or did they stray from the Path themselves?"
17.shakir: And on the day when He shall gather them, and whatever they served besides Allah, He shall say: Was it you who led astray these My servants, or did they themselves go astray from the path?
17.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when the unbelievers and whatever they had been worshipping besides God will be resurrected, He will ask the idols, "Did you mislead My servants or did they themselves go astray from the right path?"
17.mohsin_khan: And on the Day when He will gather them together and that which they worship besides Allah [idols, angels, pious men, saints, 'Iesa (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), etc.]. He will say: "Was it you who misled these My slaves or did they (themselves) stray from the (Right) Path?"
17.arberry: Upon the day when He shall muster them and that they serve, apart from God, and He shall say, 'Was it you that led these My servants astray, or did they themselves err from the way?'

18.sahih_international: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
18.pickthall: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.
18.yusuf_ali: They will say: "Glory to Thee! not meet was it for us that we should take for protectors others besides Thee: But Thou didst bestow, on them and their fathers, good things (in life), until they forgot the Message: for they were a people (worthless and) lost."
18.shakir: They shall say: Glory be to Thee; it was not beseeming for us that we should take any guardians besides Thee, but Thou didst make them and their fathers to enjoy until they forsook the reminder, and they were a people in perdition,
18.muhammad_sarwar: They will reply, "Lord, You alone deserve all glory! We were not supposed to choose any guardian other than you. Since you have been benevolent to these people and their fathers, they forgot Your guidance and, thus, became subject to perdition."
18.mohsin_khan: They will say: "Glorified be You! It was not for us to take any Auliya' (Protectors, Helpers, etc.) besides You, but You gave them and their fathers comfort till they forgot the warning, and became a lost people (doomed to total loss).
18.arberry: They shall 'Glory be to Thee! It did not behove us to take unto say, ourselves protectors apart from Thee; but Thou gavest them and their fathers enjoyment of days, until they forgot

19.sahih_international: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
19.pickthall: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.
19.yusuf_ali: (Allah will say): "Now have they proved you liars in what ye say: so ye cannot avert (your penalty) nor (get) help." And whoever among you does wrong, him shall We cause to taste of a grievous Penalty.
19.shakir: So they shall indeed give you the lie in what you say, then you shall not be able to ward off or help, and whoever among you is unjust, We will make him taste a great chastisement.
19.muhammad_sarwar: God will say (to the idolaters), "Your idols have rejected your faith. You cannot avoid their rejection nor can you find any help. Anyone of you who commits injustice will be made to suffer a great torment."
19.mohsin_khan: Thus they (false gods all deities other than Allah) will give you (polytheists) the lie regarding what you say (that they are gods besides Allah), then you can neither avert (the punishment), nor get help. And whoever among you does wrong (i.e. sets up rivals to Allah), We shall make him taste a great torment.
19.arberry: the Remembrance, and were a people corrupt.' So they cried lies touching the things you say, and you can neither turn it aside, nor find any help. Whosoever of you does evil, We shall let him taste a great chastisement.

20.sahih_international: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
20.pickthall: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.
20.yusuf_ali: And the messengers whom We sent before thee were all (men) who ate food and walked through the streets: We have made some of you as a trial for others: will ye have patience? for Allah is One Who sees (all things).
20.shakir: And We have not sent before you any apostles but they most surely ate food and went about in the markets; and We have made some of you a trial for others; will you bear patiently? And your Lord is ever Seeing.
20.muhammad_sarwar: All the Messengerss whom We sent before, certainly, ate food and walked through the streets. We have made some of you (people) a trial for the others. Would you then exercise patience? Your Lord is All-aware.
20.mohsin_khan: And We never sent before you (O Muhammad SAW) any of the Messengers but verily, they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you as a trial for others: will you have patience? And your Lord is Ever All-Seer (of everything).
20.arberry: And We sent not before thee any Envoys, but that they ate food, and went in the markets; and We appointed some of you to be a trial for others: 'Will you endure?' Thy Lord is ever All-seeing.

21.sahih_international: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
21.pickthall: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.
21.yusuf_ali: Such as fear not the meeting with Us (for Judgment) say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or (why) do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety!
21.shakir: And those who do not hope for Our meeting, say: Why have not angels been sent down upon us, or (why) do we not see our Lord? Now certainly they are too proud of themselves and have revolted in great revolt.
21.muhammad_sarwar: Those who have no desire to meet Us have said, "Would that the angels had been sent to us or that we could see our Lord." They are really filled with pride and have committed the greatest and worst kind of rebellion and hostility.
21.mohsin_khan: And those who expect not for a Meeting with Us (i.e. those who deny the Day of Resurrection and the life of the Hereafter), say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and are scornful with great pride.
21.arberry: Say those who look not to encounter Us, 'Why have the angels not been sent down on us, or why see we not our Lord?' Waxed proud they have within them, and become greatly disdainful.

22.sahih_international: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
22.pickthall: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!
22.yusuf_ali: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The (angels) will say: "There is a barrier forbidden (to you) altogether!"
22.shakir: On the day when they shall see the angels, there shall be no joy on that day for the guilty, and they shall say: It is a forbidden thing totally prohibited.
22.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when the criminals see the angels, there will, certainly, be no rejoicing for them. Rather, they will plead to the angels, "Please keep away from us (do not drive us into hell)."
22.mohsin_khan: On the Day they will see the angels, no glad tidings will there be for the Mujrimun (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, etc.) that day. And they (angels) will say: "All kinds of glad tidings are forbidden for you," [None will be allowed to enter Paradise except the one who said: La ilaha ill-Allah, "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allah) and acted practically on its legal orders and obligations].
22.arberry: Upon the day that they see the angels, no good tidings that day for the sinners; they shall say, 'A ban forbidden!'

23.sahih_international: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
23.pickthall: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.
23.yusuf_ali: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did (in this life), and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about.
23.shakir: And We will proceed to what they have done of deeds, so We shall render them as scattered floating dust.
23.muhammad_sarwar: We shall call their deeds into Our presence and scatter them into the air as dust (turn them devoid of all virtue).
23.mohsin_khan: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, etc.) did, and We shall make such deeds as scattered floating particles of dust.
23.arberry: We shall advance upon what work they have done, and make it a scattered dust.

24.sahih_international: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
24.pickthall: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;
24.yusuf_ali: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
24.shakir: The dwellers of the garden shall on that day be in a better abiding-place and a better resting-place.
24.muhammad_sarwar: The dwellers of Paradise on that day will have the best residence and resting place.
24.mohsin_khan: The dwellers of Paradise (i.e. those who deserved it through their Faith and righteousness) will, on that Day, have the best abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
24.arberry: The inhabitants of Paradise that day, better shall be their lodging, fairer their resting-place.

25.sahih_international: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
25.pickthall: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.
25.yusuf_ali: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks),-
25.shakir: And on the day when the heaven shall burst asunder with the clouds, and the angels shall be sent down descending (in ranks).
25.muhammad_sarwar: On that day the sky will be crystal blue, clear of clouds. The angels will descend in groups
25.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down, with a grand descending.
25.arberry: Upon the day that heaven is split asunder with the clouds and the angels are sent down in majesty,

26.sahih_international: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
26.pickthall: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.
26.yusuf_ali: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be (wholly) for (Allah) Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the misbelievers.
26.shakir: The kingdom on that day shall rightly belong to the Beneficent Allah, and a hard day shall it be for the unbelievers.
26.muhammad_sarwar: and the Absolute kingdom will belong to the Beneficent God.
26.mohsin_khan: The sovereignty on that Day will be the true (sovereignty), belonging to the Most Beneficent (Allah), and it will be a hard Day for the disbelievers (those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism).
26.arberry: the Kingdom that day, the true Kingdom, shall belong to the All-merciful and it shall be a day harsh for the unbelievers.

27.sahih_international: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
27.pickthall: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!
27.yusuf_ali: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a (straight) path with the Messenger!
27.shakir: And the day when the unjust one shall bite his hands saying: O! would that I had taken a way with the Apostle
27.muhammad_sarwar: It will be a hard day for the unbelievers. It will be a day when the unjust will bite their fingers, (regretfully) saying, "Would that we had followed the path of the Messengers.
27.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day when the Zalim (wrong-doer, oppressor, polytheist, etc.) will bite at his hands, he will say: "Oh! Would that I had taken a path with the Messenger (Muhammad SAW).
27.arberry: Upon the day the evildoer shall bite his hands, saying, 'Would that I had taken a way along with the Messenger!

28.sahih_international: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
28.pickthall: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!
28.yusuf_ali: "Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend!
28.shakir: O woe is me! would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!
28.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to us! Would that we had not been friends with so and so.
28.mohsin_khan: "Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had never taken so-and-so as a friend!
28.arberry: Alas, would that I had not taken So-and-so for a friend!

29.sahih_international: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
29.pickthall: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.
29.yusuf_ali: "He did lead me astray from the Message (of Allah) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!"
29.shakir: Certainly he led me astray from the reminder after it had come to me; and the Shaitan fails to aid man.
29.muhammad_sarwar: He led me away from the true guidance after it had come to us. Satan is a traitor to people."
29.mohsin_khan: "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder (this Quran) after it had come to me. And Shaitan (Satan) is ever a deserter to man in the hour of need."
29.arberry: He indeed led me astray from the Remembrance, after it had come to me; Satan is ever a forsaker of men.'

30.sahih_international: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
30.pickthall: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.
30.yusuf_ali: Then the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense."
30.shakir: And the Apostle cried out: O my Lord! surely my people have treated this Quran as a forsaken thing.
30.muhammad_sarwar: The Messengers will say, "Lord, my people had abandoned this Quran."
30.mohsin_khan: And the Messenger (Muhammad SAW) will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Quran (neither listened to it, nor acted on its laws and orders).
30.arberry: The Messenger says, 'O my Lord, behold, my people have taken this Koran as a thing to be shunned.'

31.sahih_international: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
31.pickthall: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.
31.yusuf_ali: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help.
31.shakir: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the sinners and sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and a Helper.
31.muhammad_sarwar: Thus, from the sinful people We made enemies for every Prophet. Your Lord is a Sufficient Guide and Helper.
31.mohsin_khan: Thus have We made for every Prophet an enemy among the Mujrimun (disbelievers, polytheists, criminals, etc.). But Sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.
31.arberry: Even so We have appointed to every Prophet an enemy among the sinners; but thy Lord suffices as a guide and as a helper.

32.sahih_international: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
32.pickthall: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.
32.yusuf_ali: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once? Thus (is it revealed), that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually.
32.shakir: And those who disbelieve say: Why has not the Quran been revealed to him all at once? Thus, that We may strengthen your heart by it and We have arranged it well in arranging.
32.muhammad_sarwar: The unbelievers have said, "Why was the whole Quran not revealed to him at once?" We have revealed it to you in gradual steps to strengthen your hearts and give you explanations.
32.mohsin_khan: And those who disbelieve say: "Why is not the Quran revealed to him all at once?" Thus (it is sent down in parts), that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages. (It was revealed to the Prophet SAW in 23 years.).
32.arberry: The unbelievers say, 'Why has the Koran not been sent down upon him all at once?' Even so, that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have chanted it very distinctly.

33.sahih_international: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
33.pickthall: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument.
33.yusuf_ali: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation (thereof).
33.shakir: And they shall not bring to you any argument, but We have brought to you (one) with truth and best in significance.
33.muhammad_sarwar: We will support you with the Truth and the best interpretation whenever the infidels argue against you.
33.mohsin_khan: And no example or similitude do they bring (to oppose or to find fault in you or in this Quran), but We reveal to you the truth (against that similitude or example), and the better explanation thereof.
33.arberry: They bring not to thee any similitude but that We bring thee the truth, and better in exposition.

34.sahih_international: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
34.pickthall: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road.
34.yusuf_ali: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray.
34.shakir: (As for) those who shall be gathered upon their faces to hell, they are in a worse plight and straying farther away from the path.
34.muhammad_sarwar: Those who will be driven headlong into hell will have a terrible dwelling; they have certainly gone astray.
34.mohsin_khan: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the (Straight) Path.
34.arberry: Those who shall be mustered to Gehenna upon their faces -- they shall be worse in place, and gone further astray from the way.

35.sahih_international: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
35.pickthall: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman.
35.yusuf_ali: (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister;
35.shakir: And certainly We gave Musa the Book and We appointed with him his brother Haroun an aider.
35.muhammad_sarwar: We gave the Book to Moses and made his brother Aaron his Minister.
35.mohsin_khan: And indeed We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurat (Torah)], and placed his brother Harun (Aaron) with him as a helper;
35.arberry: We gave Moses the Book, and appointed with him his brother Aaron as minister

36.sahih_international: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
36.pickthall: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.
36.yusuf_ali: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those (people) We destroyed with utter destruction.
36.shakir: Then We said: Go you both to the people who rejected Our communications; so We destroyed them with utter destruction.
36.muhammad_sarwar: We told them, "Both of you go to the people who have rejected Our revelations." We completely destroyed these unbelievers.
36.mohsin_khan: And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.
36.arberry: and We said, 'Go to the people who have cried lies to Our signs'; then We destroyed them utterly.

37.sahih_international: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
37.pickthall: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.
37.yusuf_ali: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for (all) wrong-doers a grievous Penalty;-
37.shakir: And the people of Nuh, when they rejected the apostles, We drowned them, and made them a sign for men, and We have prepared a painful punishment for the unjust;
37.muhammad_sarwar: We drowned the people of Noah because of their rejection of the Messengers and made them evidence of the Truth for mankind. We have prepared a painful torment for the unjust ones.
37.mohsin_khan: And Nuh's (Noah) people, when they denied the Messengers We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc).
37.arberry: And the people of Noah, when they cried lies to the Messengers, We drowned them, and made them to be a sign to mankind; and We have prepared for the evildoers a painful chastisement.

38.sahih_international: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
38.pickthall: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.
38.yusuf_ali: As also 'Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them.
38.shakir: And Ad and Samood and the dwellers of the Rass and many generations between them.
38.muhammad_sarwar: To each of the tribes of Ad, Thamud, the settlers around the well and many generations in between
38.mohsin_khan: And (also) 'Ad and Thamud, and the dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.
38.arberry: And Ad, and Thamood, and the men of Er-Rass, and between that generations a many,

39.sahih_international: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
39.pickthall: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.
39.yusuf_ali: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins).
39.shakir: And to every one We gave examples and every one did We destroy with utter destruction.
39.muhammad_sarwar: We gave guidance and drove each to destruction.
39.mohsin_khan: And for each of them We put forward examples (as proofs and lessons, etc.), and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin (because of their disbelief and evil deeds).
39.arberry: for each We struck similitudes, and each We ruined utterly.

40.sahih_international: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
40.pickthall: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.
40.yusuf_ali: And the (Unbelievers) must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it (with their own eyes)? But they fear not the Resurrection.
40.shakir: And certainly they have (often) passed by the town on which was rained an evil rain; did they not then see it? Nay! they did not hope to be raised again.
40.muhammad_sarwar: Our Messengers came into the town which was struck by a fatal rain. Did they (unbelievers), not see what had happened to this town? In fact, they had no faith in the Resurrection.
40.mohsin_khan: And indeed they have passed by the town [of Prophet Lout (Lot)] on which was rained the evil rain. Did they (disbelievers) not then see it (with their own eyes)? Nay! But they used not to expect for any resurrection.
40.arberry: Surely they have come by the city that was rained on by an evil rain; what, have they not seen it? Nay, but they look for no upraising.

41.sahih_international: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
41.pickthall: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger?
41.yusuf_ali: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?"
41.shakir: And when they see you, they do not take you for aught but a mockery: Is this he whom Allah has raised to be an apostle?
41.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), when they see you, they will only mock you and say, "Has God really sent him as a Messengers?
41.mohsin_khan: And when they see you (O Muhammad SAW), they treat you only as a mockery (saying):"Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?
41.arberry: And when they see thee, they take thee in mockery only: 'What, is this he whom God sent forth as a Messenger?

42.sahih_international: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
42.pickthall: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road.
42.yusuf_ali: "He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path!
42.shakir: He had well-nigh led us astray from our gods had we not adhered to them patiently! And they will know, when they see the punishment, who is straying farther off from the path.
42.muhammad_sarwar: Had we not been steadfast he would almost have led us astray from our gods." On facing torment they will soon know who had really gone astray.
42.mohsin_khan: "He would have nearly misled us from our aliha (gods), had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the (Right) Path!
42.arberry: Wellnigh he had led us astray from our gods, but that we kept steadfast to them.' Assuredly they shall know, when they see the chastisement, who is further astray from the way.

43.sahih_international: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
43.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him?
43.yusuf_ali: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion (or impulse)? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him?
43.shakir: Have you seen him who takes his low desires for his god? Will you then be a protector over him?
43.muhammad_sarwar: How can you be the guardian of those who have chosen their own desires as their Lord?
43.mohsin_khan: Have you (O Muhammad SAW) seen him who has taken as his ilah (god) his own desire? Would you then be a Wakil (a disposer of his affairs or a watcher) over him?
43.arberry: Hast thou seen him who has taken his caprice to be his god? Wilt thou be a guardian over them?

44.sahih_international: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
44.pickthall: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray?
44.yusuf_ali: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path.
44.shakir: Or do you think that most of them do hear or understand? They are nothing but as cattle; nay, they are straying farther off from the path.
44.muhammad_sarwar: Do you think that most of them listen and understand? They are like cattle or even more, straying and confused.
44.mohsin_khan: Or do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are only like cattle; nay, they are even farther astray from the Path. (i.e. even worst than cattle).
44.arberry: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle; nay, they are further astray from the way.

45.sahih_international: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
45.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;
45.yusuf_ali: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide;
45.shakir: Have you not considered (the work of) your Lord, how He extends the shade? And if He had pleased He would certainly have made it stationary; then We have made the sun an indication of it
45.muhammad_sarwar: Have you not seen that your Lord increases the shadow. Had He wanted He would have made it stationary], and has made the sun their guide.
45.mohsin_khan: Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. If He willed, He could have made it still then We have made the sun its guide [i.e. after the sunrise, it (the shadow) squeezes and vanishes at midnoon and then again appears in the afternoon with the decline of the sun, and had there been no sun light, there would have been no shadow].
45.arberry: Hast thou not regarded thy Lord, how He has stretched out the shadow? Had He willed, He would have made it still. Then We appointed the sun, to be a guide to it;

46.sahih_international: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
46.pickthall: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal?
46.yusuf_ali: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages.
46.shakir: Then We take it to Ourselves, taking little by little.
46.muhammad_sarwar: Then He reduces it in gradual steps.
46.mohsin_khan: Then We withdraw it to Us a gradual concealed withdrawal.
46.arberry: thereafter We seize it to Ourselves, drawing it gently.

47.sahih_international: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
47.pickthall: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.
47.yusuf_ali: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day (as it were) a Resurrection.
47.shakir: And He it is Who made the night a covering for you, and the sleep a rest, and He made the day to rise up again.
47.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has made the night as a covering for you, sleep as a rest for you, and the day for you to rise again.
47.mohsin_khan: And it is He Who makes the night a covering for you, and the sleep (as) repose, and makes the day Nushur (i.e. getting up and going about here and there for daily work, etc. after one's sleep at night or like resurrection after one's death).
47.arberry: It is He who appointed the night for you to be a garment and sleep for a rest, and day He appointed for a rising.

48.sahih_international: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
48.pickthall: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky,
48.yusuf_ali: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky,-
48.shakir: And He it is Who sends the winds as good news before His mercy; and We send down pure water from the cloud,
48.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who sends the winds to you with the glad news of His mercy and who sends purifying rain from the sky
48.mohsin_khan: And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain), and We send down pure water from the sky,
48.arberry: And it is He who has loosed the winds, bearing good tidings before His mercy; and We sent down from heaven pure water

49.sahih_international: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
49.pickthall: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.
49.yusuf_ali: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers.
49.shakir: That We may give life thereby to a dead land and give it for drink, out of what We have created, to cattle and many people.
49.muhammad_sarwar: to revive the barren land and provide water for many creatures, cattle, and people.
49.mohsin_khan: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give to drink thereof many of the cattle and men that We had created.
49.arberry: so that We might revive a dead land, and give to drink of it, of that We created, cattle and men a many.

50.sahih_international: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
50.pickthall: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude.
50.yusuf_ali: And We have distributed the (water) amongst them, in order that they may celebrate (our) praises, but most men are averse (to aught) but (rank) ingratitude.
50.shakir: And certainly We have repeated this to them that they may be mindful, but the greater number of men do not consent to aught except denying.
50.muhammad_sarwar: We send them rain from time to time so that they may take heed. Many people have responded, but ungratefully.
50.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have distributed it (rain or water) amongst them in order that they may remember the Grace of Allah, but most men refuse (or deny the Truth or Faith) and accept nothing but disbelief or ingratitude.
50.arberry: We have indeed turned it about amongst them, so that they may remember; yet most men refuse all but unbelief.

51.sahih_international: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
51.pickthall: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village.
51.yusuf_ali: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population.
51.shakir: And if We had pleased We would certainly have raised a warner in every town.
51.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted We could have sent a Prophet to every town.
51.mohsin_khan: And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town.
51.arberry: If We had willed, We would have raised up in every city a warner.

52.sahih_international: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
52.pickthall: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour.
52.yusuf_ali: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the (Qur'an).
52.shakir: So do not follow the unbelievers, and strive against them a mighty striving with it.
52.muhammad_sarwar: Do not yield to the unbelievers but launch a great campaign against them with the help of the Quran.
52.mohsin_khan: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them (by preaching) with the utmost endeavour, with it (the Quran).
52.arberry: So obey not the unbelievers, but struggle with them thereby mightily.

53.sahih_international: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
53.pickthall: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.
53.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed.
53.shakir: And He it is Who has made two seas to flow freely, the one sweet that subdues thirst by its sweetness, and the other salt that burns by its saltness; and between the two He has made a barrier and inviolable obstruction.
53.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has joined the two seas; one palatable and sweet, the other bitterly salty and has established a barrier between them as a partition.
53.mohsin_khan: And it is He Who has let free the two seas (kinds of water), one palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter, and He has set a barrier and a complete partition between them.
53.arberry: And it is He who let forth the two seas, this one Sweet, grateful to taste, and this salt, bitter to the tongue, and He set between them a barrier, and a ban forbidden.

54.sahih_international: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
54.pickthall: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.
54.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power (over all things).
54.shakir: And He it is Who has created man from the water, then He has made for him blood relationship and marriage relationship, and your Lord is powerful.
54.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has created the human being from water to have relationships of both lineage and wedlock. Your Lord has all power.
54.mohsin_khan: And it is He Who has created man from water, and has appointed for him kindred by blood, and kindred by marriage. And your Lord is Ever All-Powerful to do what He will.
54.arberry: And it is He who created of water a mortal, and made him kindred of blood and marriage; thy Lord is All-powerful.

55.sahih_international: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
55.pickthall: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord.
55.yusuf_ali: Yet do they worship, besides Allah, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper (of Evil), against his own Lord!
55.shakir: And they serve besides Allah that which neither profits them nor causes them harm; and the unbeliever is a partisan against his Lord.
55.muhammad_sarwar: They worship besides God things that can neither benefit nor harm them. The unbelievers are defiant against their Lord.
55.mohsin_khan: And they (disbelievers, polytheists, etc.) worship besides Allah, that which can neither profit them nor harm them, and the disbeliever is ever a helper (of the Satan) against his Lord.
55.arberry: And they serve, apart from God, what neither profits them nor hurts them; and the unbeliever is ever a partisan against his Lord.

56.sahih_international: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
56.pickthall: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
56.yusuf_ali: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition.
56.shakir: And We have not sent you but as a giver of good news and as a warner.
56.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent you for no other reason but to be a bearer of glad news and warning.
56.mohsin_khan: And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW) only as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
56.arberry: We have sent thee not, except good tidings to bear, and warning.

57.sahih_international: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
57.pickthall: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.
57.yusuf_ali: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a (straight) Path to his Lord."
57.shakir: Say: I do not ask you aught in return except that he who will, may take the way to his Lord.
57.muhammad_sarwar: Tell them, "I ask no recompense for my preaching to you, except the fact that whoever wants should choose the way of God."
57.mohsin_khan: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (that which I have brought from my Lord and its preaching, etc.), save that whosoever wills, may take a Path to his Lord.
57.arberry: Say: 'I do not ask of you a wage for this, except for him who wishes to take to his Lord a way.'

58.sahih_international: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
58.pickthall: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins,
58.yusuf_ali: And put thy trust in Him Who lives and dies not; and celebrate his praise; and enough is He to be acquainted with the faults of His servants;-
58.shakir: And rely on the Ever-living Who dies not, and celebrate His praise; and Sufficient is He as being aware of the faults of His servants,
58.muhammad_sarwar: Also trust in the Living One who never dies and glorify Him with His praise. He has sufficient knowledge of the sins of His servants.
58.mohsin_khan: And put your trust (O Muhammad SAW) in the Ever Living One Who dies not, and glorify His Praises, and Sufficient is He as the All-Knower of the sins of His slaves;
58.arberry: Put thy trust in the Living God, the Undying, and proclaim His praise. Sufficiently is He aware of His servants sins

59.sahih_international: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
59.pickthall: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!
59.yusuf_ali: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between, in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): Allah Most Gracious: ask thou, then, about Him of any acquainted (with such things).
59.shakir: Who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six periods, and He is firmly established on the throne of authority; the Beneficent Allah, so ask respecting it one aware.
59.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days and then He established His domination over the Throne. He is the Beneficent God. Refer to Him as the final authority.
59.mohsin_khan: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days. Then He Istawa (rose over) the Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty). The Most Beneficent (Allah)! Ask Him (O Prophet Muhammad SAW), (concerning His Qualities, His rising over His Throne, His creations, etc.), as He is Al-Khabir (The All-Knower of everything i.e. Allah).
59.arberry: who created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, then sat Himself upon the Throne, the All-compassionate: ask any informed of Him!

60.sahih_international: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
60.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.
60.yusuf_ali: When it is said to them, "Prostrate to (Allah) Most Gracious!", they say, "And what is (Allah) Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate to that which thou commandest us?" And it increases their flight (from the Truth).
60.shakir: And when it is said to them: Prostrate to the Beneficent Allah, they say: And what is the Allah of beneficence? Shall we prostrate to what you bid us? And it adds to their aversion.
60.muhammad_sarwar: When they are told to prostrate themselves before the Beneficent God, they say, "Who is the Beneficent God? Why should we prostrate ourselves before the one whom you have commanded us to?" This only increases their rebelliousness.
60.mohsin_khan: And when it is said to them: "Prostrate to the Most Beneficent (Allah)! They say: "And what is the Most Beneficent? Shall we fall down in prostration to that which you (O Muhammad SAW) command us?" And it increases in them only aversion.
60.arberry: But when they are told, 'Bow yourselves to the All-merciful,' they say, 'And what is the All-merciful? Shall we bow ourselves to what thou biddest us?' And it increases them in aversion.

61.sahih_international: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
61.pickthall: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!
61.yusuf_ali: Blessed is He Who made constellations in the skies, and placed therein a Lamp and a Moon giving light;
61.shakir: Blessed is He Who made the constellations in the heavens and made therein a lamp and a shining moon.
61.muhammad_sarwar: Blessed is He who has established constellations in the sky and made therein a lamp and a shining moon.
61.mohsin_khan: Blessed be He Who has placed in the heaven big stars, and has placed therein a great lamp (sun), and a moon giving light.
61.arberry: Blessed be He who has set in heaven constellations, and has set among them a lamp, and an illuminating moon.

62.sahih_international: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
62.pickthall: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.
62.yusuf_ali: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude.
62.shakir: And He it is Who made the night and the day to follow each other for him who desires to be mindful or desires to be thankful.
62.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has made the night and the day, one proceeding the other, for whoever wants to take heed or give thanks.
62.mohsin_khan: And He it is Who has put the night and the day in succession, for such who desires to remember or desires to show his gratitude.
62.arberry: And it is He who made the night and day a succession for whom He desires to remember or He desires to be thankful.

63.sahih_international: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
63.pickthall: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
63.yusuf_ali: And the servants of (Allah) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace!";
63.shakir: And the servants of the Beneficent Allah are they who walk on the earth in humbleness, and when the ignorant address them, they say: Peace.
63.muhammad_sarwar: (Among) the servants of the Beneficent God are those who walk gently on the earth and when addressed by the ignorant ones, their only response is, "Peace be with you."
63.mohsin_khan: And the slaves of the Most Beneficent (Allah) are those who walk on the earth in humility and sedateness, and when the foolish address them (with bad words) they reply back with mild words of gentleness.
63.arberry: The servants of the All-merciful are those who walk in the earth modestly and who, when the ignorant address them, say, 'Peace';

64.sahih_international: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
64.pickthall: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,
64.yusuf_ali: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
64.shakir: And they who pass the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing.
64.muhammad_sarwar: They are those who spend the night worshipping their Lord, prostrating, and standing,
64.mohsin_khan: And those who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing.
64.arberry: who pass the night prostrate to their Lord and standing;

65.sahih_international: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
65.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
65.yusuf_ali: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,-
65.shakir: And they who say: O our Lord! turn away from us the punishment of hell, surely the punishment thereof is a lasting
65.muhammad_sarwar: who pray, "Lord, protect us from the torment of hell; it is a great loss.
65.mohsin_khan: And those who say: "Our Lord! Avert from us the torment of Hell. Verily! Its torment is ever an inseparable, permanent punishment."
65.arberry: who say, 'Our Lord, turn Thou from us the chastisement of Gehenna; surely its chastisement is torment most terrible;

66.sahih_international: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
66.pickthall: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;
66.yusuf_ali: "Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in";
66.shakir: Surely it is an evil abode and (evil) place to stay.
66.muhammad_sarwar: It is a terrible abode and an evil station,"
66.mohsin_khan: Evil indeed it (Hell) is as an abode and as a place to dwell.
66.arberry: evil it is as a lodging-place and an abode';

67.sahih_international: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
67.pickthall: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;
67.yusuf_ali: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes);
67.shakir: And they who when they spend, are neither extravagant nor parsimonious, and (keep) between these the just mean.
67.muhammad_sarwar: who in their spending are neither extravagant nor stingy but maintain moderation,
67.mohsin_khan: And those, who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor niggardly, but hold a medium (way) between those (extremes).
67.arberry: who, when they expend, are neither prodigal nor parsimonious, but between that is a just stand;

68.sahih_international: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
68.pickthall: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;
68.yusuf_ali: Those who invoke not, with Allah, any other god, nor slay such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment.
68.shakir: And they who do not call upon another god with Allah and do not slay the soul, which Allah has forbidden except in the requirements of justice, and (who) do not commit fornication and he who does this shall find a requital of sin;
68.muhammad_sarwar: who do not worship idols besides God, nor without a just cause murder a soul to whom God has granted amnesty, who do not commit fornication, for those who do so have committed a sin
68.mohsin_khan: And those who invoke not any other ilah (god) along with Allah, nor kill such life as Allah has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse and whoever does this shall receive the punishment.
68.arberry: who call not upon another god with God, nor slay the soul God has forbidden except by right, neither fornicate, for whosoever does that shall meet the price

69.sahih_international: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
69.pickthall: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;
69.yusuf_ali: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy,-
69.shakir: The punishment shall be doubled to him on the day of resurrection, and he shall abide therein in abasement;
69.muhammad_sarwar: and on the Day of Judgment their torment will be double. They will suffer forever in disgrace.
69.mohsin_khan: The torment will be doubled to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace;
69.arberry: of sin-doubled shall be the chastisement for him on the Resurrection Day, and he shall dwell therein humbled,

70.sahih_international: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
70.pickthall: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
70.yusuf_ali: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for Allah will change the evil of such persons into good, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
70.shakir: Except him who repents and believes and does a good deed; so these are they of whom Allah changes the evil deeds to good ones; and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
70.muhammad_sarwar: But only those who repent and believe and act righteously will have their sins replaced by virtue; God is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
70.mohsin_khan: Except those who repent and believe (in Islamic Monotheism), and do righteous deeds, for those, Allah will change their sins into good deeds, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
70.arberry: save him who repents, and believes, and does righteous work -- those, God will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for God is ever All-forgiving, All-compassionate;

71.sahih_international: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
71.pickthall: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -
71.yusuf_ali: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah with an (acceptable) conversion;-
71.shakir: And whoever repents and does good, he surely turns to Allah a (goodly) turning.
71.muhammad_sarwar: Those who repent and act righteously have truly returned to God,
71.mohsin_khan: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds, then verily, he repents towards Allah with true repentance.
71.arberry: and whosoever repents, and does righteousness, he truly turns to God in repentance.

72.sahih_international: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
72.pickthall: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
72.yusuf_ali: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance);
72.shakir: And they who do not bear witness to what is false, and when they pass by what is vain, they pass by nobly.
72.muhammad_sarwar: those who do not testify falsely and when they come across something impious, pass it by nobly,
72.mohsin_khan: And those who do not witness falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.
72.arberry: And those who bear not false witness and, when they pass by idle talk, pass by with dignity;

73.sahih_international: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
73.pickthall: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
73.yusuf_ali: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind;
73.shakir: And they who, when reminded of the communications of their Lord, do not fall down thereat deaf and blind.
73.muhammad_sarwar: who, when reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not try to ignore them as though deaf and blind. Rather, they try to understand and think about them.
73.mohsin_khan: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
73.arberry: who, when they are reminded of the signs of their Lord, fall not down thereat deaf and blind;

74.sahih_international: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
74.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
74.yusuf_ali: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous."
74.shakir: And they who say: O our Lord! grant us in our wives and our offspring the joy of our eyes, and make us guides to those who guard (against evil).
74.muhammad_sarwar: They pray, "Lord, let our spouses and children be the delight of our eyes and ourselves examples for the pious ones."
74.mohsin_khan: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders for the Muttaqun" (pious - see V. 2:2 and the footnote of V. 3:164)."
74.arberry: who say, 'Our Lord, give us refreshment of our wives and seed, and make us a model to the godfearing.'

75.sahih_international: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
75.pickthall: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
75.yusuf_ali: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace,
75.shakir: These shall be rewarded with high places because they were patient, and shall be met therein with greetings and salutations.
75.muhammad_sarwar: They will all receive Paradise as their reward for their forbearance and patience, where they will be greeted with, "Peace be with you."
75.mohsin_khan: Those will be rewarded with the highest place (in Paradise) because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.
75.arberry: Those shall be recompensed with the highest heaven, for that they endured patiently, and they shall receive therein a greeting and --' Peace!'

76.sahih_international: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
76.pickthall: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!
76.yusuf_ali: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest!
76.shakir: Abiding therein; goodly the abode and the resting-place.
76.muhammad_sarwar: They will live therein forever, the best abode and place of rest.
76.mohsin_khan: Abiding therein; excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to dwell.
76.arberry: Therein they shall dwell forever; fair it is as a lodging-place and an abode.

77.sahih_international: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
77.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
77.yusuf_ali: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)!"
77.shakir: Say: My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer; but you have indeed rejected (the truth), so that which shall cleave shall come.
77.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say (to the disbeliever) "It does not matter to my Lord whether you worship Him or not. You have rejected His guidance and your punishment is inevitable."
77.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW to the disbelievers): "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied (Him). So the torment will be yours for ever (inseparable permanent punishment)."
77.arberry: Say: 'My Lord esteems you not at all were it not for your prayer, for you have cried lies, and it shall surely be fastened.'
